purpose: Small foundation contract for the rebuilt low-layer organism baseline.

scope: CYNIC is a low-layer Rust runtime organism before it is a product surface.
Runtime truth is proved by executable code, OS services, registry placement, and runtime read-back.
Dead documentation, deleted organs, and historical Python gates cannot define current authority.
Solana is a piece of engineering: study its solutions and patterns for anything useful to CYNIC.

Canonical internal integrity hashing is SHA3-512 (prefix sha3-512:). SHA-256 remains mandated only where an external contract requires it (on-chain program payloads, third-party APIs); BLAKE3 is permitted for high-throughput non-canonical caches. Every digest string carries its algorithm prefix; unprefixed digests are invalid.

hard_boundaries.name: low_layer_first
hard_boundaries.rule: Kernel, host, node, protocol, MCP, CLI, storage, and service supervision take precedence over UX and product layers.

hard_boundaries.name: rust_runtime_authority
hard_boundaries.rule: Durable runtime authority must live in Rust crates, infra placement, or machine-readable contracts.

hard_boundaries.name: provider_agnostic_domain
hard_boundaries.rule: Domain logic must not depend on a specific LLM, browser, host, hypervisor, or cloud provider.

hard_boundaries.name: portable_host_contract
hard_boundaries.rule: Host and node capabilities must be represented as portable ports before concrete adapters.

hard_boundaries.name: runtime_proof_over_prose
hard_boundaries.rule: A claim about organism liveness is valid only when it can be checked through build output, service state, health/read-back, or persisted runtime evidence.

hard_boundaries.name: no_contract_forest
hard_boundaries.rule: Do not create broad contract trees. Add a new contract only when a stable boundary cannot be expressed in Rust types, tests, registry, or this file.

hard_boundaries.name: fractal_agent_recursion
hard_boundaries.rule: Every node may own a local recursive agent tree. Child delegations must preserve node lineage, monotonically reduce authority and budgets, consume content-addressed context, and return proofs or explicit unknowns upward. Cross-node delegation is federation and requires an explicit coordination contract.

hard_boundaries.name: sovereign_error_codes
hard_boundaries.rule: Every CYNIC contract violation surfaces as a typed sovereign error code (cynic.error_catalog.v1: CynicErrorCode), never as a free-form string. Codes carry a two-axis classification: (1) domain (Build, Network, Lxc, Breakglass, Activation, Agent, Fleet, OsHealth) derived from an enum, not hardcoded; (2) nature (Blocked | Recoverable | Constitutional | AgentResolution). A Blocked code has no safe forward path without an authority escalation (admission grant, breakglass, constitutional consent); it must never be bypassed by a manual workaround. A Recoverable code resolves only through its bounded, reviewable remediation or a dependency restore — never a silent retry. The operator string CYNIC-{PREFIX}-{NNN} is derived from (domain.prefix, domain_index), so the number cannot drift from addition order.

hard_boundaries.name: no_manual_blocker_bypass
hard_boundaries.rule: A blocker (Blocked-class error code) is resolved only by the typed reconciliation or authority-escalation path that owns it. Ad-hoc shell fixes, local fallbacks, or prose claims that omit the code are not convergence and must be rejected by read-back proof.

hard_boundaries.name: organic_opportunities_inform_priority
hard_boundaries.rule: Operator priority is continuously informed by fresh, attributable organic opportunities: observed unfinished work, recurring friction, emerging patterns, plumbing debt, or cross-surface dependencies with estimated unlock value and energy. An opportunity is a contestable read-only proposal, never a task, claim, grant, urgency signal, or mutation authority. A higher-unlock opportunity must be surfaced before an agent spends a bounded budget on a lower-unlock planned item, unless the operator explicitly records another choice. This law never overrides human sovereignty, admission, capability boundaries, consent, safety gates, or independent read-back proof.

hard_boundaries.name: mcp_is_projection_not_bootstrap
hard_boundaries.rule: MCP is a replaceable projection of stable contracts and local CLI/read-back surfaces. A missing, removed, unavailable, or incompatible MCP artifact must be retained as an explicit unknown but cannot be a bootstrap prerequisite for local read-only observation or a human-admitted bounded local source slice. MCP rebuild begins only after the projected contracts and local proof are stable; it must not own policy, scheduling, or coordination authority.

hard_boundaries.name: explicit_over_implicit
hard_boundaries.rule: The implicit is debt. Every intent, decision, gap, budget, recipient, schema version, and migration step must be explicit, typed, and machine-readable, or recorded as an owned explicit unknown with due scale. Nothing is back-filled by guess: a missing observer, adapter, proof, budget, or address is reported as unknown or blocked, never fabricated into a successful-looking report. Guessing where a type, test, contract, or proof could answer is a constitutional violation.

hard_boundaries.name: strict_dag_and_single_responsibility
hard_boundaries.rule: Every crate follows the canonical cynic-<family>-<role> taxonomy. Architecture is a strict downward DAG (Layer 4 Projections -> Layer 3 Orchestrators -> Layer 2 Domains -> Layer 1 Host Substrate -> Layer 0 Pure Protocol). Cross-family concrete coupling, upward dependencies, God-object orchestrators exceeding 25k LOC, and domain I/O outside injected ports are constitutional violations.

build.default_gate: make check on a build runner holding a signed, workload-derived machine grant bound to the durable record revision, lease fence, cancellation generation, node, commit, canonical action set, and expiry; make authority-check is the read-only local authority gate
build.build_gate: blocked until a real registry-selected build runner verifies the machine signature plus the live durable workload and returns argv execution and artifact digest evidence
build.release_gate: cynic_validate action=build_release is the canonical release-build request; release remains blocked until its admitted build proof and artifact read-back are satisfied
build.test_gate: build-runner only; local Cortex execution is not test proof
build.check_stack: make check and the Cargo wrapper must refuse compiling actions unless CYNIC_BUILD_ADMISSION_GRANT names a machine-signed cynic.build.workload_grant.v1 derived from a live claimed workload; the sole seed-only exception is a root-owned, exact node + source commit + registry digest MachineEnrollment receipt consumed by scripts/build-runner-bootstrap before any runtime marker exists, and it becomes invalid as soon as the bootstrap completion read-back is persisted; HumanAdmin may enroll or rotate the machine build authority but may not mint routine build grants; admitted execution uses CARGO_INCREMENTAL=0 and the repository-pinned toolchain
build.build_stack: make build uses RUST_MIN_STACK=536870912 and CARGO_INCREMENTAL=0 because rustc 1.96.0 remains unstable while linking workspace debug binaries
build.release_stack: make build-release uses RUST_MIN_STACK=1073741824 and CARGO_INCREMENTAL=0 because rustc 1.96.0 remains unstable during release/profile compilation
build.policy: Build policy may evolve, but it must stay executable from the repository root. A compiler ICE is toolchain debt, not runtime proof, and the canonical local workaround must stay explicit.

runtime.runtime_seed: cynic-host-exec is a separately governed bootstrap root, excluded from ordinary runtime baskets; it admits signed content-addressed baskets bound to an exact source commit and admitted build proof through monotonic release epochs, two-slot atomic activation, postflight read-back, and rollback
runtime.policy: Runtime placement may evolve through registry and service templates, not through stale narrative docs. Registry nodes are targets until local proof promotes them to observed/locked.

agent_exposure.audit: cynic dev agent-exposure --json (also folded into cynic dev surface-audit --json)
agent_exposure.validate_gate: MCP tool cynic_validate plans or durably submits canonical `make check`, `make build`, or `make build-release` workloads to the registry-selected build_runner and never compiles in the agent worktree; the target node must persist the exact admitted envelope before acknowledging delivery; after durable claim the node-owned scheduler derives and signs the machine grant without HumanAdmin input; execution remains blocked until signer, verifier, executor transport, cancellation, recovery, and completion read-back are wired
agent_exposure.policy: Expose every currently implemented Rust MCP tool with domain and tier labels. Keep projections portable (no committed machine-local absolute paths). Legacy Python proxies and the legacy AgentTask queue are not mutation execution authority. docs/ prose is historical and not runtime authority. Agent and operator validation share `make check`, but only an admitted build runner may execute it.

organic_opportunities.policy: The local read-only compass observes attributed session-derived friction and source-state evidence, then proposes contestable opportunities ranked within an explicit contextual value frame. Every proposal retains sources, freshness, estimated energy, expected unlock value, confidence, and residual unknowns. It never creates work, changes priority, writes skills, publishes telemetry, or mutates source/runtime without a separate human-admitted action and read-back proof.
forbidden_substitutions: MCP availability as a prerequisite for local observation

infra_retention.keep_rule: Keep infra files that deploy, secure, configure, or inspect the active low-layer runtime.
infra_retention.delete_rule: Delete committed runtime snapshots, UX containers, organ remnants, and provider experiments unless they are required by registry or systemd.

minimum_local_proof: make check from an explicitly admitted build runner
binary build after rustc ICE/toolchain pin is resolved
systemd unit inventory matches infra/registry.json service names

vertical_contracts.rule: Every runtime vertical must name desired state, observation, reconciliation, bounded action, read-back proof, owner, and coverage. Unknown coverage is data and cannot be promoted to success.

future_distributed_proof: cynic bootstrap constellation --json reads registry targets and reports missing proof without mutating
kernel stores observations and task read-back
MCP exposes read-only runtime status to agents

node-owned recursive agent schedulers persist and enforce cynic.agent_workload_envelope.v1, including admitted delegation and policy, idempotency, aggregate budgets, cancellation, lease fencing, recovery, and completion evidence
